title: No French or Creole where she lived
summary: She says everyone was American with no French or Creole speakers, though the man knows Creole people.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did they talk any French up where you were? No, ma'am. I didn't have no talking French. Creole? I can't imagine.
All American? They didn't have no Creole people up there? No Creole people where I lived there.
Like I know Creole people though. I know. I'm so shaped with Creole people.
